name: The Hallowed Widow
description: White angel wings and a golden halo disguise a dark, bristling flying spider with red eyes and ivory fangs.
implementation_status: Proximity swoop integrated in build49; packaged checks pass, visual review pending

backstory.text: For years, the worst thing about a basement spider was losing sight of it. Then one sprouted wings and apparently started breeding. The Hallowed Widow is a huge, hairy nightmare with ivory fangs, white feathers, and a golden halo—every reassuring detail attached to the wrong animal. Early witnesses watched the floor. Later witnesses learned to watch the ceiling, too. Nobody knows where the wings came from. Religious and non-religious people alike have expressed concerns about what this implies for heaven.
backstory.canon_note: User-selected magazine prose synchronized by Storyboarding review. Breeding is narrative wording, not a reproduction mechanic.
